headline: Rockwell Automation Reports Q4 Earnings Boosted by Strong AI Demand
summary: Rockwell Automation released its Q4 2026 earnings transcript, noting that its margin goal was reached three years early as AI demand lifted results.
why: Industrial automation companies benefit from secular trends in factory automation and artificial intelligence integration.

impacts.name: Rockwell Automation Inc.
impacts.why: Strong earnings results and early margin target achievement directly reflect positive operational performance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
